_comment: Registry of monitored countries. REVIEWER WORKFLOW: after verifying an entry against the official source, set last_verified to the date (YYYY-MM-DD) and write verified_summary in your own words. The site only shows summaries for verified entries. URLs seeded here MUST be checked and corrected during setup.

countries.name: United States
countries.authority: FDA / U.S. Customs and Border Protection
countries.notes: Personal importation policy; controlled substances also governed by DEA rules.

countries.name: Canada
countries.authority: Health Canada / Canada Border Services Agency
countries.notes: Personal use quantities; controlled substances need additional documentation.

countries.name: Japan
countries.authority: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW)
countries.notes: Yakkan shoumei (import certificate) system; stimulants strictly prohibited including some common ADHD medications.

countries.name: Australia
countries.notes: Traveller's exemption; three-month supply rule for most prescription medicines.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.notes: Approval required in advance for several categories; strict penalties.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.notes: Electronic permit for controlled/narcotic medicines; enforcement is strict.

countries.name: Germany
countries.authority: BfArM (Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices)
countries.notes: Schengen Article 75 certificate for narcotics when travelling within Schengen.

countries.name: France
countries.notes: Schengen Article 75 certificate applies; quantities generally limited to duration of stay.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.notes: Category-based rules; some psychotropics require Form IC-2 permit in advance.

countries.name: India
countries.authority: CDSCO / Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
countries.notes: Personal-use quantities with prescription; NDPS Act governs narcotics.

countries.name: Mexico
countries.notes: Prescription and reasonable personal quantity; controlled substances need permit.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.notes: Personal import rules; controlled list subject to RDC resolutions.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.notes: Section 21 and personal medicine import guidance; scheduled substances restricted.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.notes: Strict on psychotropics and narcotics; declaration required.

countries.name: Philippines
countries.notes: Personal-use exemptions with prescription; Dangerous Drugs Board rules for controlled substances.

countries.name: China
countries.notes: Reasonable personal quantities; psychotropics and narcotics tightly controlled.
